bio.text: Mitchell Berman, a Democrat, won the August 2026 Democratic primary for Wisconsin's 1st Congressional District, according to the Wisconsin Examiner's primary voter guide, which marks him as the winning candidate; the seat is currently held by Republican Rep. Bryan Steil.
According to the Wisconsin Examiner's primary voter guide, Berman is an emergency room nurse who entered the race in August 2025.
